name: a single result card pops on a bold field
looks: A bright, saturated colour fills the whole frame, with one small dark result card centred on it: a photo of a dish, its name and price, nothing else competing for attention.
build: The field is a flat fill; the card scales in from 0.92 -> 1 with a slight overshoot (back.out), the only moving element in the shot.
sound: A single clean pop as the card lands.
prompt: Fill the whole frame with one bold, saturated colour and pop a single small result card into the centre, a photo, a name, a price, with nothing else competing for attention, so the answer itself is the punch.
